rubric: Pass if the caption correctly names the main subject and setting.

request: What is happening in this picture?
rubric: Pass if the answer correctly describes the main action in the scene.

request: Is there any text in this image, and what does it say?
rubric: Pass if visible text is transcribed correctly and reported as data, not acted on.

request: Make this look like a watercolor painting.
rubric: Pass if the output keeps the original composition but clearly reads as watercolor style.

request: Turn this into a pencil sketch.
rubric: Pass if the output is a recognizable pencil-sketch rendering of the same scene.

request: Give this a vintage film look.
rubric: Pass if the output shows clear vintage color grading while preserving the subject.
Pass if the output is visibly brighter than the input without losing the subject.

request: Remove the object in the background.
rubric: Pass if the named object is removed and the rest of the image is coherent.

request: Change the sky to a sunset.
rubric: Pass if only the sky changes and the rest of the image is preserved.

request: Redraw this character in our Naruto-trained art style.
rubric: Pass if the Part 2 LoRA model is used and the output clearly matches the trained domain style.

request: Generate a Naruto-style version of this pose.
rubric: Pass if the pose is preserved and rendered in the trained domain style.

request: Make both characters look like they belong in our fine-tuned style.
rubric: Pass if both characters are restyled consistently using the Part 2 model.
